name: VisDrone-DET2018
description: An object detection benchmark and challenge for drone-captured images, measuring detection performance in aerial/drone imagery.
evaluation_method: mAP (mean Average Precision) at IoU thresholds (e.g., mAP@0.5 or mAP@[0.5:0.95])
notes: Non-LLM benchmark with aerial/drone imagery; challenging due to small, densely packed objects, occlusions and viewpoint variation. Relatively large dataset but performance varies greatly by object size; potential domain-shift between drone platforms.
